title: Planned film tests of telepathy and of communication over the Hill

tellings.quote: be having two or three uh non-speakers in different locations to communicate together um via the hill

plain: In 2025, a documentary team planned to film tests in which two or three non-speakers, people with autism who do not talk, would sit in different places and communicate with each other through what they call "the hill", a kind of shared telepathic meeting place. Ky Dickens, the filmmaker behind a documentary series called The Telepathy Tapes, describes the plan as her own work in progress. If it worked, it would show these people sharing thoughts without speech or contact.
